content.title: Sean Penn Ghosted the 2026 Oscars. Here’s Why
content.text: Paul Thomas Anderson’s One Battle After Another scored the Best Picture Oscar at Sunday’s 2026 Oscar ceremony, after Sean Penn set the tone for a One Battle triumph with a win for Best Supporting Actor earlier in the night. Anderson took home Best Director as well as Best Screenplay, which he dedicated to his kids (“To say sorry,” he said, “for the housekeeping mess that we left in this world we’re handing off to them, but also with the encouragement that they will be the generation that hopefully brings us some common sense and decency.”)Anderson's One Battle antagonist Sean Penn, a two-time winner and six-time nominee before tonight, has been known to liven up an Oscar telecast with a zinger or two—when he won for Mystic River in 2004, his speech began, “If there’s one thing that actors know, other than that there weren’t any WMDs,” but as of last week Penn had missed several precursor ceremonies, including the BAFTAs and the Actor Awards, despite winning at both. He went into Sunday night a likely winner but also a likely no-show.Read on to learn whether Penn, Brad Pitt, Connor Storrie, and other stars made it to the Academy Awards this year.Was Sean Penn at the Oscars?Warner Bros./Everett CollectionNo; while Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor at Sunday's Oscars ceremony for his performance as the corrupt military leader Col. Steven J. Lockjaw, the One Battle After Another actor wasn’t present at the show. Instead, according to the New York Times, the actor headed to Europe, en route to Ukraine. The purpose of his visit remains unknown, but in 2022, during a previous visit to Ukraine, the actor gave President Volodymyr Zelenskyy one of his Oscars, after suggesting to Variety that they could be “melted down to bullets” to help with the Ukrainian war effort.Penn famously does not think highly of the Academy, who he accused in 2024 of exhibiting “extraordinary cowardice when it comes to being part of the bigger world of expression, and in fact, have largely been part of limiting the imagination and very limiting of different cultural expressions.” And in 2023 Penn blasted the producers of the ceremony for refusing to let him speak after the Ukraine invasion: “The Oscars producer thought, ‘Oh, he’s not light-hearted enough.’ Well, guess what you got instead? Will Smith!”Not to be out-zinged, Kieran Culkin, who presented the absent Penn with his award, said that Penn “couldn’t be here this evening, or didn’t want to,” before accepting on Penn’s behalf.Was Brad Pitt at the Oscars?Brad Pitt and Flea during Game Four of the 2025 World Series.Emma Sharon/Getty ImagesWhile F1’s Damson Idris rocked a Prada overcoat on the Oscar red carpet this evening, his famous co-star and fellow F1 producer Brad Pitt was nowhere to be seen. This isn’t the first time Pitt has skipped out on an Academy Awards ceremony: he was also a no-show in 2017, the year the Best Picture Oscar went to Barry Jenkins' Moonlight, produced by Pitt’s Plan B Entertainment. Later it was revealed that on the night in question, Pitt had been “holed up creating a sculpture” in the British artist Thomas Houseago’s studio in L.A.’s Frogtown district, and “had been at it for nearly 10 days.”Was Connor Storrie at the Oscars?Connor Storrie at the Actor Awards on March 1.Julian Hamilton/GA/Getty ImagesStorrie and his Heated Rivalry co-star Hudson Williams have certainly been making the rounds in Los Angeles during Oscar weekend, at events like CAA’s annual Pre-Oscar party. But while Williams graced the Oscar red carpet in Balenciaga, Storrie wasn’t anywhere in sight.Was Lewis Hamilton at the Oscars?Lewis Hamilton after the Formula 1 Chinese Grand Prix in Shanghai, China on March 15.NurPhoto/Getty ImagesLewis Hamilton, who produced the Best Picture nominee F1—and played himself in the film—was unable to make it back from Shanghai for the award show following his participation in the Chinese Grand Prix. While the F1 driver has had a tough season thus far, his turn in China found him back on the podium for the first time since he began driving for Ferrari.Was Hailee Steinfeld at the Oscars?Hailee Steinfeld at the 83rd Annual Golden Globes held at The Beverly Hilton on January 11, 2026 in Beverly Hills, California. (Photo by Maya Dehlin Spach/2026GG/Penske Media via Getty Images)2026GG/Getty ImagesNo—while Hailee Steinfeld stars in Sinners, the film with the most Oscar nominations ever, the actress wasn’t present at the evening’s ceremony. During his acceptance speech for Best Actor, Sinners star Michael B. Jordan explained, “[Hailee’s] getting ready to have a baby right now.” The actress is currently expecting her first child with Josh Allen, star quarterback for the Buffalo Bills.Was Thomas Pynchon at the Oscars?Portrait of Thomas Pynchon, 1955.BettmannAuthor of the 1987 novel Vineland, adapted for the screen by Oscars 2026 Best Director Oscar winner Paul Thomas Anderson as One Battle After Another. PTA thanked him from the stage, but Thomas Pynchon was not at the Oscars. He famously rejects publicity and until recently the only confirmed photographs of him were from the 1950s. There’s a rumor that he’s in Anderson’s Inherent Vice or maybe a deleted scene from Inherent Vice, but who knows. It would have been weird if he’d been there, but you never know.
